limitations: The theorem excludes the endpoint pure-power estimate but does not prove that the infimum power exponent exceeds \(1/(p-1)\), does not establish optimality of the logarithmic exponent \(1/p\), and makes no \(p=1\) claim. Lerner's \(p=2\) construction and recurrence are prior work.
